items.excerpt: Epic shipped Unreal MCP — the Model Context Protocol plugin introduced in UE 5.8 — inside UEFN, embedding an MCP server in the editor so agentic coding tools like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can write and compile Verse, place and configure devices, and run play sessions with the creator.

The Fortnite Ecosystem v42.00 release notes bundle Unreal MCP support for agentic coding tools alongside touch gestures, an experimental ability framework and new environment assets — putting AI-assisted authoring into the default UEFN creator workflow.

DeepMind traces 15 years of game AI research from Atari agents to persistent online worlds, and announces a partnership with Fenris Creations to prototype AI agents inside the EVE Universe — a bid to turn research agents into shipped gameplay design.

Former Maxis engineer David 'Rez' Graham and ex-Take-Two AI head Luke Dicken unpack what actually matters about AI in game development beyond the hype — separating classic game AI craft from generative tooling and its effect on the nature of the work.

A Gamescom dev-speaker survey finds 83% of developers expect generative AI to change team productivity or structure within three years, with 36% predicting reshaped roles rather than smaller teams and 30% wanting AI kept out of production.

Saber Interactive CEO Matt Karch apologized to former lead writer Stella Sacco after she said she was 'replaced with ChatGPT' mid-production on Rideshare 'Stimulator'; the studio committed to adding an AI disclosure to the game's Steam page.

System 3's James Pond Legacy trailer and character artwork drew accusations of generative-AI use — melted details, inconsistent props — even as the studio insists 'no generative AI was used,' another flashpoint in how players now read game art.

Aftermath walks through the visual tells in the James Pond Legacy cover and trailer that read as AI-generated, against System 3's denial — a case study in how audiences now audit promotional art frame by frame.

Patrice Desilets defends AI-generated imagery in 1666: Amsterdam's reveal, arguing 'I can ask the AI to give me 75 different variations' at a speed human illustrators couldn't match — a blunt statement of the iteration-vs-craft tradeoff.

Skillprint's Signal Benchmark scores how well AI models can shift players toward a target mental state, adjusting game parameters in real time — framing adaptive difficulty and pacing as a measurable, model-driven design layer.

Ubisoft reports Rainbow Six Siege cut critical toxic voice chat by 50% using Modulate's ToxMod, with roughly 800,000 hours of voice audio analyzed monthly — AI moderation as a shipped part of live-service experience design.
